# Expected raw HUD examples

Manually constructed test fixtures, not model responses. All optional groups OFF; no relationships are invented or deleted.

```text
Season: Spring (calendar)
Location: A roadside shelter

Rudeus Mode: Replacement
Condition: Stable
***
```
